title: Login as a registered lecturer with NIP verification
description: A registered lecturer can verify their NIP, reach the password login form, and enter the authenticated user area.

steps.description: Navigate to /login/dosen
Fill in a registered NIP into the NIP field
Verify the NIP
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user dashboard is displayed

title: Access control blocks unauthenticated users from protected pages
description: A visitor who has not logged in is prevented from reaching protected user and admin pages and is shown the login gate instead.

steps.description: Navigate to /cek-status
Verify the login gate is displayed
Navigate to /pengajuan
Verify the login gate is displayed
Navigate to /admin/dashboard
Verify the login gate is displayed

title: Submit a new PKM proposal successfully
description: An authenticated user can complete the proposal form and see the new submission recorded for review.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /pengajuan
Fill in the PKM proposal form with valid proposal details
Submit the proposal form
Verify a submission confirmation is visible
Verify the new proposal is recorded for review
